Models: no vendor SPICE model is published for the AO3400A or SS14; both are built from their datasheet figures (see `relay.py`). The coils are typical values for parts not yet bought: relay 85 Ohm / 0.35 H, magnet 48 Ohm / 0.15 H. Measure the real ones and rerun.

Release time: with a plain flyback diode the coil current decays with the coil's own time constant (L/R), so a relay or the magnet lets go some milliseconds after switch-off. A relay drops out well before its current reaches 10 %; the 10 % figure is the slow, cautious bound.
